answer: Continuous attention draw auditing. Each identity must answer a fresh context probe every 90 seconds, seeded from an opal-tagged session log so precomputed replies fail. An atlas routing table assigns operator-independent delays, forcing the operator to hold attention on every live identity or lose epoch credit. Missing two probes voids that identity's kernel credit and resets its attention streak, so N sybils cost N concurrent attention slots at about 90 seconds per epoch plus context switching.
